column1: # THE SHIPPING RECIPE CATALOG.
# Emptied on strawberry's request 2026-09-06 ("completely empty crafting list"); these are the first
# entries authored back into it, from the same day: "add recipes for crafting Logs -> planks and planks
# -> sticks needs saw, not consumed".
# The 1875 extracted retail rows are NOT deleted -- they live beside this file as blueprints.retail.tsv,
# which the index/filter/search tests load as their fixture. Re-adding a recipe means appending a row here.
# Format (tab-separated, 8 columns): owner  operation  name  skill  level  inputs  outputs  stations
#   inputs  = guid:amount:consume|...   consume 0 = a TOOL: must be held, is NOT spent
#   outputs = guid:amount|...           set EXPLICITLY here so the yield is 2, and so DoCraft actually
#                                       grants something -- it only ever adds bp.Outputs, and every retail
#                                       row leaves that column empty and implies the owner instead.
# FromTsv skips any line with fewer than 8 tabs, which is why these comments cost nothing.
# OPTIONAL TAIL (columns 9-11, any can be left blank):  seconds  unlocks  key
#   seconds = how long one unit takes (blank = the 1 s base)
#   unlocks = BLANK -> everyone knows the recipe (every row below). Anything here LOCKS it until one fires:
#               skill:<skill>:<level>   learned automatically at that level (names as the console's `skill` verb)
#               item:<itemId>           using that item (a schematic) teaches it and spends one
#               learn                   only the admin console (`learn <key|item name>`, `learnall`)
#             pipe-separate several, e.g.  skill:crafting:3|item:1234
#             A locked recipe is hidden from browsing and only turns up, padlocked, in a typed search.
#   key     = the stable id a player's knowledge is SAVED under. Leave blank to derive it from the recipe's
#             contents; give one if you expect to edit a locked recipe's ingredients later and want everyone
#             who learned it to keep it.
# The saw is item 141 (fd6bee...), "Construction tool for cutting lumber". NOT item 1704, which is also
# called "Saw" but is the Epic holiday candy-cane chainsaw reskin -- requiring that would have put every
# one of these recipes behind a seasonal drop.
# Species is preserved end to end: a birch log yields birch planks, never pine.
# BLACK POWDER AND GUNPOWDER (strawberry 2026-10-07: "add a recipe for sulfur + charcoal to make black
# powder. black powder + fertilizer = gunpowder"). Two steps on purpose, as asked -- the intermediate is a
# real item you can hold and trade, not a hidden stage inside one recipe.
# MAKESHIFT SCOPE (strawberry 2026-10-07: "give the makeshift scope a recipe, binoculars + tape"). Owner is the
# binoculars: it is the part you are sacrificing, and the recipe should surface on the thing you are holding.
# WATER BOTTLE SILENCER (strawberry 2026-10-07: "crafted w a water bottle + tape. attaches to any weapon w the bottle
# model on the tip of the muzzle. breaks after the first shot"). Bottled Water (14) + Tape (69) -> item 9400.
